commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

sessionId.description: The session the prompt is in: needed only when its id is parked in more than one session (conflict ambiguous_prompt).

decision.description: Whether the call may go ahead: allow, or deny.

answers.description: A question prompt's answers, keyed by the question's text.

updatedInput.description: A permission prompt's tool input as edited; the model's own when absent.

mode.description: An approved plan's mode to continue in, clamped to the run's ceiling; acceptEdits when absent.

remember.description: Ask no more for this tool in this session: permission prompts only, with an allow.
